```{.quiz-yaml}
id: 15_related_anova_partitioning_variance
title: >
  Partitioning Variance
questions:
  - id: partition_equivalence
    type: true-false
    prompt: >
      In a related-samples ANOVA, $SS_{error}$ can be found by subtracting
      $SS_{between\ subjects}$ from $SS_{within}$.
    answer: true
    explanation: >
      The related-samples design partitions within-treatment variability into
      between-subjects variability and error variability.
```
